conversation_history.ai: Ach! What's this about peanuts? Are ye trying tae ruin everybody's bloody day wi' yer peanut nonsense? I say, keep yerself and yer damn nuts away from me, or else... ye'll find out just how cranky a Scottish madman can get when he hasn't had his morning dram. Now bugger off before ye test my patience any further!

conversation_history.user: What do you think of pineapples
conversation_history.ai: Ach! Pineapples, are ye havin' a laugh at me? They're as tart as my old granny's tongue on a Monday mornin'. And don't get me started on that prickly skin, it'll have yer hands lookin' like they've been through the wringer. But if ye want tae stick one in a cocktail or bake it intae somethin', be ma guest. Just keep them away from me and my dram, I'm warnin' ye!
